address.title: bStock token contract
address.description: The bStock proxy on BNB Smart Chain. Register the PROXY, not the implementation. Do not identify a bStock by its symbol — impersonators with the same symbol exist on BSC.

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Token decimals. Every genuine bStock is 18. This only controls formatting; the multiplier is always divided by 1e18.

registry.title: OnRecord Registry
registry.description: Registry on this chain. When set, the token must hold the required tier at the record block or scoring fails. Strongly recommended — it is what ties voting weight to the on-chain whitelist.

requireTier.title: Required registry tier
requireTier.description: 1 = TIER_SHARE, an issuer-backed bStock (default). 2 = TIER_PRE_SHARE, a Four.meme 4Stock, which tracks a share without being one.

beacon.title: Expected EIP-1967 beacon
beacon.description: Defaults to the bStocks beacon 0x156d6dce9a4f6139a3406f1f021f1a4880de93a3, which all genuine bStocks delegate to. Override only to test against a non-bStock.

deployBlock.title: Token deployment block
deployBlock.description: Optional. Narrows the archive canary, which otherwise probes block 1.
